description: This file defines a benchmark test class 'StartupMacrobenchmark' that performs startup and UI interaction performance measurements on an Android application using the AndroidX Benchmark library. It contains test methods for cold startup and startup with UI scrolling, utilizing methods for benchmarking and device control.

classes.name: StartupMacrobenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark test class for measuring app startup and UI performance metrics.

methods.name: coldStartup
methods.description: Performs a cold startup benchmarking measurement with 10 iterations.

methods.name: startupAndScrollFrameTiming
methods.description: Performs startup benchmarking combined with UI scrolling actions to measure frame timing metric.

methods.name: runBenchmarkOrSkip
methods.description: Executes a benchmark run, skipping if device-specific known issues occur.
